Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Game: Papers, Please checkpoint simulation. Day 2 completed; Day 3 beginning.

CONTROLS: Drag documents between counter slot (~0.15,0.51) and desk. Click loudspeaker (~0.301,0.234) to call next entrant. Click stamp tray (~0.986,0.46) to open/close; approval stamp at ~(0.977,0.243), denial stamp knob at ~(0.635-0.675,0.375). Drag stamp knob onto document's ENTRY VISA box to apply ink—drop point must land inside the dotted rectangle. Return stamped documents by dragging to counter slot, then upward through slot to complete handoff.

RULES LEARNED: Day 2 (1982.11.23): Allow Arstotzkan citizens with valid passports; deny foreigners. CRITICAL: Arstotzkan citizens are valid regardless of passport issuing city (East Grestin, West Grestin, etc.)—earlier hypothesis that East Grestin was invalid was WRONG. Photo must match entrant. Approval shows green 'ARSTOTZKA WELCOMES YOU' banner; denial causes entrant to leave immediately.

DAY 2 RESULTS: 6 entrants processed. 5 citations accumulated during day; 6th citation at end assessed 5-credit penalty for incorrectly denying Lichtenzweig, Irena (ARSTOTZKA, ISS East Grestin, photo mismatch noted but she was clear for entry—photo rule application uncertain). Day ended early due to terrorist attack story event. Salary 5 credits, penalty -5 credits, net 0 from work. Rent -20, medicine -5 (purchased for sick son), food/heat unaffordable. Deficit -15 credits carried forward.

FAMILY STATUS: Wife hungry, son sick+hungry (medicine bought), mother-in-law hungry, uncle hungry. No food or heat purchased.

UNRESOLVED: Exact photo-matching rule (Lichtenzweig had non-matching photo per citation but was marked clear for entry). Issuing-city rule for foreigners vs. citizens needs bulletin re-check on Day 3. Citation penalty threshold uncertain.

NEXT: Day 3 starting; expect new bulletin with updated rules.
